title: Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2023

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2023
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 176
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 176
ACT XVI OF 2023
PUNJAB PROCUREMENT REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab Procurement
Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
7th June, 2023]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(77)/2020/109, dated 7.6.2023.---The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Bill 2020,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of
January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 23rd day of
January 2023, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
(VIII of 2009) for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment)
Act, 2023.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
